units.source_text: 佛法的轮回转世一说，似乎也是这个世界的伦理的象征。

en.t: The Buddhist doctrine of reincarnation seems also to be a symbol of the ethics of this world.

units.source_text: 前生的鹰变成今生的人，

en.t: the hawk of a former life becomes a person in this life,

units.source_text: 或今世的人变成来世的蝴蝶，或变成佛，

en.t: or a person in this life becomes a butterfly in the next life, or becomes a Buddha,

units.source_text: 全都在于今世修行的因果报应。

en.t: and all of it depends on the karmic consequences of one's practice in this life.
